import pandas as pd


def run(inputs: dict[str, pd.DataFrame]) -> dict[str, pd.DataFrame]:
    df = inputs["transactions"].copy()

    df = df.sort_values(
        by=["account_id", "txn_date", "txn_seq"],
        kind="mergesort"
    ).reset_index(drop=True)

    amount_filled = df["amount"].fillna(0)
    running_balance = amount_filled.groupby(df["account_id"]).cumsum()

    overdraft_flag = (running_balance < 0).astype("int64")

    result = pd.DataFrame({
        "account_id": df["account_id"],
        "txn_seq": df["txn_seq"],
        "txn_date": df["txn_date"],
        "amount": df["amount"],
        "running_balance": running_balance,
        "overdraft_flag": overdraft_flag,
    }).reset_index(drop=True)

    return {"acct_balance_flags": result}
